articles.summary: Global Coffee Platform acknowledges Raíz as equivalent to the Coffee Sustainability Reference Code Little Rock, Ark., December 18, 2024 — Westrock Coffee proudly announces that its Raíz Sustainability™ initiative has been recognized by the Global Coffee Platform (GCP) as equivalent to the Coffee Sustainability Reference Code (Coffee SR Code) under the 2nd party assurance category. articles.title: Westrock Coffee Achieves Recognition for Raíz Sustainability™ Initiative
